name: codex-agent-manager
description: Clarify coding requests, publish or save an executable spec, and run Codex or an external coding agent with auditable logs.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify, spec, delegate, and verify coding work.
interface.longDescription: Codex Agent Manager uses grilling for adaptive requirements clarification, to-spec for issue-backed or local specifications, and an explicit executor choice between the current Codex Agent, Kiro CLI, Cursor Agent, and Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Clarify this request, then ask whether to enter to-spec.
Create an issue-backed or local-only spec for this change.
Choose Codex, Kiro, Cursor, or Claude to execute this spec.
